def run() -> None:
    cursor = load_cursor()
    log("bridge_started", cursor=cursor)
    while True:
        try:
            rows = pending(cursor)
            for rowid, text, sender, direct_verified in rows:
                key = normalize_sender(sender)
                if not direct_verified or not key or key not in ALLOWED:
                    save_cursor(rowid)
                    cursor = rowid
                    log("message_skipped_unverified_chat" if not direct_verified else "message_skipped_unapproved", rowid=rowid)
                    continue
                answer = ask_herald(text, sender, rowid)
                send_imessage(sender, answer, rowid)
                save_cursor(rowid)
                cursor = rowid
                log("message_delivered", rowid=rowid)
        except (OSError, sqlite3.Error, urllib.error.URLError, RuntimeError,
                subprocess.SubprocessError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
            log("bridge_retry", cursor=cursor, error=type(exc).__name__)
            time.sleep(10)
        else:
            time.sleep(2)
